# 💳 gws Gmail Triage

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Gmail-triage module of the gws CLI: show an unread inbox summary with sender, subject and date (`gws gmail +triage`), with options for max messages, custom Gmail search queries and label names. Read-only — it summarizes, it never modifies mail. Distinct from the already-listed gws-gmail (general module) and gws-gmail-send: this is the focused triage subcommand, same format as the other gws subcommand listings. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it only summarizes — triaging still needs your judgment (or another skill); the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
